Alex: Heads-up: the generate endpoint example in the API reference uses `Content-Type: application/json` in the schema but the curl snippet is using `--form` (multipart). That confuses users and our codeblock-runner tests fail. I can open a docs PR unless someone else is on it.
Priya: Can you paste the bad snippet?
Alex: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -F "input=Hello" \
  -F "model=rwkv-14b"  # <-- oops
```
DocsBot: PR draft created: alex/generate-example-fix — checks: codeblock-runner failed
Sam: I checked the schema — the endpoint expects JSON. Example body should use `-d`/`--data` or `--data-raw` and `JSON.stringify` in JS. Also the JS example on the same page is building a `FormData` object.
Mike: I can take the JS snippet. Will update it to match `Content-Type: application/json` and `max_new_tokens`. Also add a short note about streaming headers.
Priya: Also there's a mismatch in param name: examples use `max_tokens` but our runtime expects `max_new_tokens` for generate. We should standardize on `max_new_tokens` across examples.
Alex: Good catch. I'll update the curl and python snippets and swap param names. Will also add a tiny integration test that runs the curl/JS snippets with the docs test harness.
Sarah: When you update, run `yarn docs:build` and preview at `/api-reference/generate` to sanity-check rendering.
Sam: I'll review the PR. Tagging @DocsBot for preview deploy when it's up.
DocsBot: Preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3421/generate
Mike: Pushed JS changes to branch `alex/generate-example-fix`. New snippet:
```js
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwkv-14b', input: 'Hello', max_new_tokens: 16 })
});
const data = await resp.json();
console.log(data);
```
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll update python too and replace `max_tokens`.
Alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 — requesting review from @Sam and @Priya. Tests: codeblock-runner ✅
Sam: Quick nit: include a one-liner about `Content-Type` for streaming SSE vs chunked responses (so readers don't confuse streaming headers with request headers).
Mike: Added note and small example for SSE headers.
Sam: Approving now. Merge when green.
DocsBot: PR #3421 merged by Sam. Production docs updated and deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/generate
Alex: Thanks all — path is clean. Closing this thread.
